title: Riot X Nic Salts Blue Razz Sour Watermelon 10ml E-Liquid
description: Blue Razz Sour Watermelon from Riot X brings together tangy Blue Raspberry and juicy Watermelon with a sour twist for a punchy fruit blend that keeps your taste buds on their toes. The Raspberry brings a ruby-red tang, balanced by the soft sweetness of fresh, ripe Watermelon. A subtle sour edge rounds out the profile, making this a bold and satisfying all-day vape. Formulated with Riot Squad’s innovative Hybrid Nicotine blend — a combination of freebase and nicotine salts — this e-liquid delivers a smooth yet tactile throat hit with fast-acting nicotine relief. Its 50VG/50PG ratio ensures rich flavour with discreet vapour, perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping in pod kits and starter devices . Part of the Riot X Nic Salts range, this e-liquid is made in the UK and designed to deliver double-concentrated flavour that mimics the intensity of disposable-style blends. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. Please note: this flavour profile may contain hints of 'ice'.
